fields.why: Tables 1–2 give one survey-adjusted Wald chi-square p-value per characteristic across 4 age groups, 4 race/ethnicity groups and 4 insurance groups.
Age, race/ethnicity and current health insurance (SES) each have 4 levels tested; sex and the confidentiality and risk factors are two-level or not SPDs.
One shared p-value per characteristic is a homogeneity test; the text's contrasts (15–17 vs 20–22 and 23–25; public and no insurance vs private) are correctly captured as resolves_to_finer.
